6311.title: Navigation updates replace Markdown media elements
6311.rootCauseOneLine: A navigation-context update changes linkRouting, rebuilding closure component types and replacing an unchanged video node.
6311.proposedFix: Keep renderer component types stable and provide changing routing/policy via a render-scoped context; preserve routing updates without remounting media.
6311.caveats: DOM lifecycle and currentTime loss reproduced in two clean checkouts. No real media decoding or macOS desktop run. Browser Automation could not open because this host has no Chrome/Chromium. Test and evidence are embedded inline under the reports repository policy. Fix was skipped at the eligibility check because linked PR koenvg/bb-plugins#357 was then open; it merged before publication.
